rules.quote: Use %d for int, %D for long.
rules.rule: When writing an mlwrite format string, use %d for int values and %D for long values; never use %ld, since mlwrite does not recognize the 'l' modifier.

rules.quote: Any time writing an mlwrite format string with a long value, use %D.
rules.rule: When writing an mlwrite format string with a long value, use the %D format specifier.

rules.quote: User-facing destination buffers (e.g. @buffername in pipe commands) must use flag=0.
rules.rule: When creating user-facing destination buffers (such as @buffername targets in pipe commands) via bfind(), pass flag=0 rather than BFTEMP.

rules.quote: Only use BFTEMP for internal editor buffers like [List].
rules.rule: Use the BFTEMP flag with bfind() only for internal editor buffers such as [List].

rules.quote: Auto-wrap operations (on insert and delete) must never move the cursor to a different position than where the user placed it.
rules.rule: Never move the cursor to a different position during automatic wrap operations on insert or delete; keep it where the user placed it.

rules.quote: Any wrap/reflow triggered automatically (not by M-q/M-Q) must be cursor-anchored.
rules.rule: Any automatically triggered wrap or reflow (not triggered by M-q or M-Q) must be anchored to the cursor.

rules.quote: fillpara must NOT be called from auto-wrap paths.
rules.rule: Do not call fillpara from automatic auto-wrap code paths.

rules.quote: Only call fillpara from explicit user commands (M-q, M-Q).
rules.rule: Only call fillpara in response to explicit user commands M-q or M-Q.

rules.quote: Always `git add` any new memory files created during a session when making commits.
rules.rule: When making commits, always git add any new memory files created during the session under .claude/memory/.

rules.quote: When staging files for a commit, include any new or modified files under `.claude/memory/`.
rules.rule: When staging files for a commit, include any new or modified files under .claude/memory/.

rules.quote: Don't let them accumulate as untracked files.
rules.rule: Do not let .claude/memory/ files accumulate as untracked files.

rules.quote: Always update `VERSION_NAME` in `main.c` as part of any commit.
rules.rule: Update VERSION_NAME in main.c as part of every commit.

rules.quote: increment the number (e.g. `ME2.08` → `ME2.09`) when committing a named release.
rules.rule: When committing a named release, increment the version number in VERSION_NAME (e.g. ME2.08 → ME2.09).

rules.quote: append "X" suffix (e.g. `ME2.09` → `ME2.09X`) when making changes that don't warrant a new version number.
rules.rule: When making informal changes that don't warrant a new version number, append an "X" suffix to VERSION_NAME (e.g. ME2.09 → ME2.09X).

rules.quote: Version bump is part of the commit checklist — do it before committing, not as a follow-up.
rules.rule: Perform the VERSION_NAME version bump before committing, not after as a follow-up.

rules.quote: Pick up these threads when the user wants to continue.
rules.rule: When the user wants to continue the discussion, pick up the threads recorded in this memory file (Lua/config, GPG encryption, buffer piping, markdown rendering, macro library).

rules.quote: Don't re-litigate the Lua question
rules.rule: Do not re-litigate whether to embed Lua into the editor; that question is settled.

rules.quote: GPG is additive, not a Blowfish replacement.
rules.rule: Treat GPG encryption as an addition alongside the existing Blowfish encryption path, not as a replacement for it.

rules.quote: only explicit keystrokes move the cursor
rules.rule: Only explicit user keystrokes may move the cursor; never move the cursor as a side effect of other operations.

rules.quote: Auto-wrap on insert and delete must be cursor-stable.
rules.rule: Auto-wrap triggered by inserting or deleting text must not move the cursor.
